title: Clocks
hook: Why *Clocks* never feels like it lands
cover_text: The *minor chord* that keeps it floating

chords.name: Bbm
chords.text: B♭ *minor*, not major: *D♭* instead of D.

chords.name: Fm
chords.text: The ii: *F minor*. A real V never comes.

chords.name: Eb
chords.text: No leading tone, *no pull*. So it floats.
